blocks.text: In Barangay Sapangdaku, Cebu City, caring for the forest is more than an environmental activity, it is part of everyday life for communities that live and work around the watershed. On September 26, 2026, Visayan Electric employee volunteers joined the Philippine Business for Social Progress (PBSP) and the Baksan Sapangdaku Farmers Association in planting around 3,000 seedlings across the remaining 20 hectares of the 150-hectare target under the Cebu A-Park project, supporting the long-term rehabilitation of the Buhisan Watershed and the natural resources that Cebu communities depend on.
